gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-thai-loope: Noto Sans Thai Looped has tall bodies that make its lowercase look almost bold, with generous gaps left at the curve ends. Noto Sans Thai Looped holds up over a full page, each line feeling sturdy yet unclogged, while Tilt Neon keeps its tube-like curves up top.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Noto Sans Tifinagh uses rounded, inviting letters whose bowls fill the line like inflated shapes, set under Tilt Neon's ring-like o. Over many lines it stays friendly.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: A single thick thread seems to trace every letter of Tilt Neon, curves never thinning at the turns. Noto Sans Tirhuta is its opposite, a sans with cut-back terminals and a dominant x-height, so the two feel like a rope beside an open window.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Approachable is the body's mood. Tilt Neon keeps a steady pen pressure from first letter to last and excels at loud display moments, while Noto Sans Ugaritic, with its tight cap-to-lowercase gap and open chalk-arc mouths, handles the quieter sentences.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-vai: Modern in feel, Tilt Neon joins its strokes without any thinning or bulging at the joints. Noto Sans Vai answers with sans-serif words that read as solid blocks, leaving generous space between curve ends and stems, so heading and text sit snugly together.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Tilt Neon looks like a bent paperclip, bold and commanding with no swelling anywhere in its line. And Noto Sans Vithkuqi follows with open throats on a, c, e and s, plus a minimal step from capitals to lowercase.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-wancho: A lowercase a with no thin hairline strokes is what sets Tilt Neon apart, a heavy tube of a letter. But Noto Sans Wancho matches that weight with hulking, chalk-thick lowercase, and the wide gap in its e is what really holds them together.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-warang-cit: Noto Sans Warang Citi makes words read as solid blocks, with wide channels leading into each counter, under Tilt Neon's round bowls. Make this body font's size generous.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-yi: Commanding is how Tilt Neon draws its round letters, like bent wire, so it earns its keep big and brief. Noto Sans Yi takes the text with a deep midsection in the lowercase and rounds left unsealed, like an unlatched hook.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-: Approachable and bold meet here, with Tilt Neon's pen-plotter smoothness beside a soaring x-height. But Noto Sans Zanabazar Square brings wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, and that crispness is the pair's strongest quality.
